scope: Allocation omission uses current Method facts and current permission operations without running allocation effects
retained_checks: Method context participates in exact binding facts
Replacing ObjectModel allocation, vtable allocation or GC preparation prevents omission without entering the replacement
Current binding-query and allocation-policy failures preserve exact native failure identity
Forwarding replacements cannot make captured canonical queries approve their own replacement
Custom method lookup on the allocation owner is declined without being invoked
Restoration is observed immediately and ordinary Word construction still succeeds
migration_note: The unexported legacy BindingGuard byte/native-entry helper is not recreated. Tests use the existing Oop Method-fact operation and the permission owners actual dependencies. Vtable allocation is intercepted on the vtable owner, not the Word instance vtable.
